name: Microsoft
summary:
The Microsoft favicon is the four-square mark on microsoft.com, not the legacy Windows tile set (70, 144, 150 and 310). Those tile sizes are documented in the favicon dimensions guide. The files here are the ones this host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against microsoft.com. HTML came from https://www.microsoft.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://www.microsoft.com/favicon.ico?v2.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.microsoft.com/favicon.ico?v2. The saved file favicon.ico is 17174 bytes. Directory sizes: 128×128, 72×72, 48×48, 32×32, 24×24, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.microsoft.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 57×57 jpeg.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: jpeg-57x57-01.jpg at 57×57 (jpeg, 843 bytes) from https://www.microsoft.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
